notes: Development follows the revised plans for The Colonnade Phase III.

All building sides must be faced with face brick, stone, concrete, aluminum, glass, stucco or similar quality face materials; wood veneer over an approved structural frame is allowed where the Building Code allows it.
The applicant must dedicate right-of-way for a free right-turn lane and a single-point-urban interchange on the north side of the property.
All driveways, parking areas, access easements and walkways must be illuminated.
Refuse containers must be screened from public streets by a solid fence or wall at least 6 ft high.
Mechanical equipment must be located and screened so it does not disturb occupants of adjoining buildings.
No accessory use may keep articles, goods or materials in the open or exposed to public view.
